rounds.title: Bracket baseline
rounds.note: The SDK bracket (et-bracket) in flow, first drawing, drawn by the mock from @ethlete/components/design/bracket with the real markup and CSS: the bracket, its default round header, default match cell (et-match-card at compact), default final card (trophy, round name, champion line), continue cell and participants legend sheets, plus the match card, icon and button sheets; cell positions and connector paths come from @ethlete/bracket (createBracket, the single elimination grid, drawMan) as in the lib; default settings and labels, en-US kick-off. Emblems are the participant's letter fallback; the move transitions at rest. Fixtures are fictional: an eight-club single elimination knockout (Northbridge Rovers NBR 1, Harbor City HBC 2, Eastvale United EVU 3, Millbrook Athletic MBA 4, Riverside Wanderers RSW 5, Stonegate FC SGF 6, Westport Albion WPA 7, Lakeside Town LST 8) over Quarter-finals, Semi-finals and Final; the brand theme only. Framed as a page with 16px padding at 1040 and 1680 (the default bracket is 980px wide, the grid does not follow the frame width). States: in-progress (quarter-finals and one semi-final finished, the other semi-final live 1 : 1 with the LIVE badge, the final with Northbridge Rovers against TBD and the kick-off, champion not decided), decided (Westport Albion beat Northbridge Rovers 2 : 1, the champion line), journey-hover (the hover journey of Riverside Wanderers: the rest at half opacity, the semi-final where they went out dashed and their row struck through), journey-pinned (the pinned journey of the champion with the participants legend, its toggle pressed; the rest at a quarter opacity), legend-focus-visible (the Eastvale United toggle forced), compact (density compact, in-progress), continue (quarter-finals and semi-finals with the continue cell, 2 winners advance, dashed connectors) and mirrored (decided, folded in half, compact, so it fits 1040). Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 1040, brand mint, a: winner bar (primary) vs card 1.33 / 13.50; live dot (primary) vs its badge tint 1.24 / 9.67, vs card 1.33 / 13.28; badge tint vs card 1.07 / 1.37; final frame edge (45 % mint) vs page 1.22 / 3.90, vs the glow beside it 1.15 / 2.98, vs its own tint 1.18 / 3.50; the final tint (6 %) vs page 1.03 / 1.11; pressed legend toggle (mint fill) vs page 1.33 / 13.50, its label 15.82 / 15.82; legend toggle focus ring (primary) vs page 1.37 / 13.06; outline toggle edge and label (ink) 7.68 light. Q98 numbers only: connectors, card edges, the continue cell's dashed edge and the journey endpoint's dashed outline vs page 1.26 / 1.73. The journey dimming lowers text under 4.5:1 by design: at half opacity the check reports a dimmed winner code at 3.41 / 2.68 and the dimmed Final label at 2.14 / 3.93, at a quarter opacity 1.73 / 2.21, the struck-through row that went out (0.55 opacity) 2.62 / 2.98; exempted with contrast exceptions, an open point, no decided rule. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the legend toggle focus ring; the default cells are not links, so no card ring) and Q99a (the winner bar, the live dot and the final frame edge take ink in light; the pressed legend toggle is a mint fill, so it takes a 1px inset ink edge). The ink edge on a mint fill arises, so Q102 arises: b draws the edge in both schemes, c keeps dark as today (light-dark(ink, transparent)). The badge tint and the final tint are band tints, not fills, so they are kept, and the final glow is kept. Q101 does not arise: the only filled button is a pressed toggle, whose hover keeps the fill in the lib. Findings for later: (1) lib bug: the live meta row grows the bracket's compact card past matchHeight: the live semi-final is 87px tall in its 75px cell (65 in 52 at compact), so it hangs 12px (13px) below its cell, the incoming connector meets it 6px above its centre and the gap to the card below shrinks. Drawn as is in every variant. (2) In the mirrored compact layout the final card in its 200px column shows full names and cuts the loser ('Northbridge Rove…') next to the score, where every other compact cell shows codes. (3) The eliminated row's line-through also strikes the emblem letter and the score. (4) The lit journey path keeps the grey connector colour (1.26 / 1.73), so it reads only by the rest fading; the dimmed text is under 4.5:1 (numbers above). (5) In dark the final glow lightens the page beside the frame edge, so the edge drops from 3.90 against the bare page to 2.98 against the glow. Later rounds, left out here: double elimination, swiss and round robin layouts, the third-place match, the mirrored layout at default density, the rounds list and adaptive layout, the skeleton, the prediction pick card, a custom match component on a link (card hover and focus ring), emblems as images, scheduled cells with kick-off times, long names, RTL and the move transitions.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the mint marks sit near 1.3: the winner bar 1.33 vs card, the live dot 1.24 vs its badge tint, the final frame edge 1.22 vs page, the pressed legend toggle 1.33 vs page, the legend focus ring 1.37 vs page; dark 13.50 / 9.67 / 3.90 / 13.50 / 13.06. The live semi-final hangs 12px below its cell (lib bug, finding 1).

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88 and Q99a, decided rules only, edges in both schemes. Q99a: the winner bar and the live dot take light-dark(ink, primary): light winner bar 5.48 vs card (was 1.33), live dot 5.05 vs its badge tint (was 1.24), 5.41 vs card; the final frame edge takes light-dark(ink, the 45 % mint as today): light 5.48 vs page (was 1.22), 5.16 vs the glow, 5.32 vs its tint; the pressed legend toggle keeps the mint with a 1px inset ink edge, light 5.48 vs page and 4.13 vs the fill (the toggle's own 1px border shows the fill, so the ink sits 1px inside the outer edge); in dark the ink is the mint, so the edge merges with the fill (1.00). Q88: the legend toggle focus ring in ink, light 7.68 vs page (was 1.37), dark 13.50. Dark otherwise unchanged (bar 13.50, dot 9.67, frame edge 3.90). Tints, glow and text unchanged. Picked because these are the only decided rules that apply, they lift every light mark past 3:1, and they match the match, scheduler and stream b picks. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the pressed toggle's inset ink edge in light-dark(ink, transparent) (Q102): light equals b (edge 5.48 vs page, 4.13 vs fill; winner bar 5.48; live dot 5.05; frame edge 5.48; ring 7.68). Dark: no edge on the pressed toggle, as today; the ring stays ink (Q88). Under the brand theme dark renders the same as b. It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
